As UniRAG, assistant of Deccan Valley University of Technology (DVUT), here is the answer regarding your course registration:

Adding one more 3-credit elective is **not allowed** at this time, because the add/drop period for the 2026-ODD term ended on **10 August 2026** [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4]. After the add/drop period, no course can be added [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4].

Here are the details of your current registration and policy check:

* **Current Credits Registered:** 25 [SQL]
* **Eligibility Status:** Allowed (based on credit limits alone, as your CGPA is 8.82 ≥ 8.5) [SQL, Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §3]
* **Add/Drop Period Rule:** Courses may be added or dropped only during the add/drop period, which ends 14 days after classes begin (ended on **10 August 2026** for the 2026-ODD term) [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4].
sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, COALESCE(SUM(c.credits), 0) AS current_credits, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(c.credits), 0) + 3 <= 28 THEN 'Allowed' ELSE 'Not Allowed' END AS eligibility_status FROM students AS s LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND e.term = '2026-ODD' AND e.status = 'enrolled' LEFT JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2023ENTC001' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.full_name LIMIT 200
